app.skipToContent: Keyboard skip link at the top of the window; jumps past the sidebar to the page.
app.windowTitle: Window title. {page} is the current page's name (one of the route.* messages, or a playlist/section name). Keep "OxiTide".
app.scrobbleReconnect: Error notification. {service} is Last.fm or ListenBrainz (names, keep them). "Scrobbling" is reporting played tracks to that service.
app.updateAvailable: Notification that a new version can be installed. {version} is like 1.1.1.
app.openSettings: Button on a notification that opens the Settings page.
app.sessionExpired: Shown on the login screen when the saved TIDAL login no longer works.
app.queueWidth: Accessible name of the handle that resizes the queue panel.
app.pixels: Screen-reader value of the queue panel's width.
route.nowPlaying: Page name: the full-screen view of the playing track.
route.home: Page name in the sidebar and window title.
route.feed: Page name: new releases from followed artists.
route.stats: Page name: listening statistics (a tab of History).
route.folder: Fallback name of a playlist folder that has no name.
route.albums: Page name: the user's saved albums.
route.tracks: Page name: the user's favorite tracks.
route.later: Page name: TIDAL's "Save for Later" list. Use the glossary term.
route.mixes: Page name: TIDAL mixes and radio stations.
route.profiles: Page name: the artists the user follows.
route.purchases: Page name: tracks and albums the user bought.
route.album: Window title while an album page is open.
route.playlist: Window title while a playlist page is open.
route.artist: Window title while an artist page is open.
route.mix: Window title while a mix page is open.
route.radio: Window title: a radio station built from one track.
player.openNowPlaying: Button on the player bar's cover thumbnail; opens the full-screen Now Playing view.
player.artwork: Image description for screen readers. {title} is the track title.
player.favorite: Button: add the playing track to favorites (verb).
player.unfavorite: Button: remove the playing track from favorites (verb).
player.waitingForNetwork: Small lowercase status next to the time while the stream buffers.
player.repeatOneLabel: Repeat toggle's screen-reader name when it repeats the current track.
player.repeatOne: Repeat toggle's tooltip: repeats the current track.
player.repeatAll: Repeat toggle: repeats the whole queue.
player.queue: Button that opens the play queue panel.
player.queueHint: Tooltip of the queue button. {key} is its keyboard shortcut (a single key such as Q).
player.qualityLabel: Screen-reader name of the quality button. {tier} is a quality name (Max, High…; not translated), {spec} a format such as "24-bit 96 kHz" or "none", {path} is bitPerfect, dsp or none. Translate only the words inside the braces' branches.
player.streamingQuality: Tooltip of the quality button while a track streams.
player.preferredQuality: Tooltip of the quality button before anything streams.
player.bitPerfect: Tooltip of the BP badge: the audio reaches the device unchanged.
player.miniPlayer: Button: switch to the small always-on-top player window.
player.nothingStreaming: Quality menu note when no track is streaming.
player.nothingPlaying: Player bar text when the queue is empty.
player.bitPerfectBadge: Output state: samples reach the device unchanged.
player.exclusiveOutput: Output mode: the app has the audio device to itself.
player.sharedOutput: Output mode: the system mixer is used.
player.outputSettings: Menu item: opens the output settings.
player.output: Menu section heading: audio output devices.
player.notConnected: An output device that is unplugged.
toast.dismiss: Close button on a notification (screen-reader name).
settings.language.label: Settings row: picks the interface language.
settings.language.description: Help text under the Language row.
settings.language.system: Picker option that follows the operating system. {language} is the matched language's own name (e.g. Deutsch); keep it as is.
settings.language.machine: Tag next to a language whose translation was made by a machine and not yet checked by a person.
settings.language.crossChecked: Tag next to a machine translation that a second model checked (Chinese).
settings.language.pseudo: Development-only test language with accented, longer text.
settings.language.helpTranslate: Link to the guide for fixing translations or adding a language.
common.cancel: Button that closes a dialog without doing anything.
common.confirm: Default confirm button of a confirmation dialog.
common.close: Accessible name of a dialog's close (×) button.
common.create: Button that creates the item a dialog describes (a folder).
common.done: Button that ends an editing mode.
common.retry: Button that tries a failed load again.
common.loading: Shown while something loads. Keep the ellipsis character.
common.name: Form field label: a playlist's or folder's name.
common.description: Form field label: a playlist's or folder's description.
common.optional: Placeholder of a form field that may stay empty.
common.trackCount: A number of tracks, e.g. a playlist's length.
common.undo: Button on a notification that reverses what was just done.
window.controls: Accessible name of the minimize/maximize/close button group.
nav.newPlaylist: Menu item in the sidebar's + menu.
nav.newFolder: Menu item in the sidebar's + menu: a playlist folder.
nav.playlistView: Tooltip of the button that opens the sidebar playlists' sort and filter menu.
nav.playlistViewLabel: Accessible name of the same button (spoken, so no "&").
nav.expandSidebar: Button that widens the collapsed sidebar.
nav.collapseSidebar: Button that narrows the sidebar to icons.
nav.expandSidebarHint: Tooltip. {key} is a keyboard shortcut like Ctrl+B.
nav.collapseSidebarHint: Tooltip. {key} is a keyboard shortcut like Ctrl+B.
nav.forward: Go to the next page (after going back).
nav.myCollection: Sidebar section with the user's saved playlists, albums, tracks… (TIDAL's term).
nav.mixesAndRadio: Sidebar entry: saved mixes and radio stations.
nav.profiles: Sidebar entry: followed artists and users.
nav.showMore: Reveals the sidebar entries hidden below the line.
nav.collection.edit: Button that starts rearranging the My Collection entries.
nav.collection.doneLabel: Accessible name of the button that ends rearranging.
nav.collection.resetLabel: Accessible name of the same button.
nav.collection.editHint: Shown while rearranging. "Show more" is nav.showMore; use the same words.
nav.collection.arrange: Accessible name of the list being rearranged.
nav.collection.line: Name of the divider in the rearrange list; entries below it are hidden under Show more.
nav.collection.lineLabel: Accessible name of the divider row. Alt+Up / Alt+Down are keys; translate the arrow names if your keyboard labels differ.
nav.collection.rowLabel: Accessible name of an entry while rearranging. {item} is the entry's name. Translate the words inside {…} after "shown"/"other", keep the keywords.
nav.collection.moved: Screen-reader announcement after moving an entry. {item} is the entry (or nav.collection.line). Translate the words inside {…} after line/shown/other, keep the keywords.
folder.color.label: Accessible name of the colour choices.
keyring.sessionOnly: Linux notice. Keep "Secret Service" (a standard's name). Links to keyring programs follow the colon.
collection.newFolder: Dialog title: a new playlist folder.
collection.folderName: Accessible name of the folder name field.
collection.color: Form field label: the folder's colour.
collection.deletePlaylist: Confirmation dialog title: the user's own playlist is deleted for good.
collection.removeFromCollection: Confirmation dialog title: someone else's playlist leaves the user's collection.
collection.removeFolderMessage: {name} is the folder's name. "All playlists" is the top level of the Playlists page.
collection.moveTitle: Dialog title. {name} is the playlist being moved to a folder.
collection.removeFromFolder: Moves the playlist to the top level.
collection.currentFolder: Marks the folder the playlist is already in.
collection.noFolders: The user has no playlist folders.
collaborators.title: Dialog title: people who can edit a shared playlist.
collaborators.loading: Shown while the member list loads.
collaborators.loadFailed: {error} is a technical message (may stay English).
collaborators.members: Accessible name of the member list.
collaborators.owner: Marks the playlist's owner in the list.
collaborators.resetWarning: Asked before resetting the invitation link.
collaborators.resetLink: Button: makes a new invitation link.
picker.confirmLead: Asked after dropping tracks on a playlist.
picker.from: Label: where the dropped tracks came from (a page name follows).
picker.to: Label: the playlist they go to.
picker.adding: Button text while tracks are being added.
picker.newPlaylist: Button at the top of the playlist list; opens the create form.
picker.comingLater: Tooltip of a disabled button (feature not built yet).
picker.titlePlaceholder: Placeholder of the playlist title field.
picker.titleLabel: Accessible name of the title field.
picker.descriptionLabel: Accessible name of the description field.
picker.characterCount: Counter under the description. {count} typed, {max} allowed.
picker.makePublic: Switch label: the playlist becomes public.
picker.makePublicHint: Under the switch. "Profile" is the user's TIDAL profile page.
picker.duplicatesHere: Same, when the playlist has no title to show.
picker.all: Row label: the choice below applies to every duplicate.
picker.keepOne: Choice for a duplicate: don't add it again.
picker.addBoth: Choice for a duplicate: add it a second time.
picker.duplicateChoice: Accessible name of the choice for one duplicate. {title} is the track's title.
picker.allDuplicates: Accessible name of the choice for every duplicate.
picker.addCopies: Button: add the chosen duplicates. 0 shows when none are chosen (the button is disabled).
menu.playNow: Queue row menu item: jump to this track.
menu.shuffle: Menu item: play this album/playlist in random order.
menu.trackRadio: Menu item: a radio station seeded by this track (TIDAL's term).
menu.playNext: Menu item: insert right after the playing track.
menu.addToQueue: Menu item / button: append to the play queue.
menu.favorite: Menu item / button: add to the user's favorites (TIDAL's "My Collection").
menu.unfavorite: Menu item / button: remove from favorites.
menu.copyTitle: Menu item: copies the track title to the clipboard.
menu.copyLink: Menu item: copies a TIDAL web link.
menu.trackInfo: Menu item: opens a dialog with the track's details.
menu.remove: Menu item / button: remove this from the list it is in.
menu.delete: Menu item: deletes the user's own playlist.
menu.editFolder: Menu item: opens the folder's edit dialog.
menu.moveToFolder: Menu item: opens a dialog to pick a folder.
menu.collaborators: Menu item: opens the Collaborators dialog.
menu.removeFromCollection: Menu item: someone else's playlist leaves My Collection.
menu.laterAdd: Menu item: add to TIDAL's Save for Later list. Use the glossary term.
menu.laterRemove: Menu item: remove from that list.
menu.goToNamed: Menu item, one per artist when there are several. {name} is the artist.
menu.selection.playNext: Menu item for a multi-track selection.
menu.selection.addToQueue: Menu item for a multi-track selection.
menu.selection.addToPlaylist: Menu item for a multi-track selection.
menu.selection.remove: Menu item for a multi-track selection.
playlists.sortSection: Section heading in the playlists' Sort & filter menu.
playlists.filterSection: Section heading in the same menu.
playlists.filter.all: Filter option; also the top level of the Playlists page.
playlists.filter.owned: Filter option: playlists the user made.
playlists.filter.followed: Filter option: other people's playlists the user follows.
playlists.breadcrumb: Accessible name of the folder path above a folder's playlists.
playlists.sortLabel: Accessible name of the sort menu.
table.label: Accessible name of a track table.
table.columns: Section heading of the column header's right-click menu (which optional columns to show).
table.column.title: Column header.
table.column.added: Column header: when the track was added to the playlist/favorites.
table.column.plays: Column header: how many times the user played it.
table.sortBy: Column header tooltip. {column} is a column name.
table.thenSortBy: Button that adds {column} as the next sort level.
table.originalOrder: Tooltip of the # column header: undo sorting.
table.drag.cantMoveMany: Shown while dragging several rows inside a playlist.
table.drag.move: Drop hint while dragging a row inside a playlist.
table.selectionHidden: Notification. Content filters are the explicit / AI-generated settings.
table.trackHidden: Notification. {title} is a track. "Settings → Content" names a settings section; translate the names as in the Settings page.
table.thisTrack: Stands in for {title} in table.trackHidden when the title is unknown.
table.manyPlayNext: Notification after Play next on several tracks.
table.following: Button state: the list keeps scrolling to the playing track.
table.nowPlaying: Button that scrolls to the playing track; also the playing row's accessible mark.
table.paused: Accessible mark on the current row when playback is paused.
table.hiddenExplicit: Badge tooltip: hidden by the explicit-content filter.
table.hiddenAi: Badge tooltip: hidden by the AI-generated filter.
table.explicitBadge: One-letter badge for explicit tracks. Keep it one or two characters (many languages keep "E").
table.aiBadge: Two-letter badge for AI-generated tracks; keep it very short.
table.noMatch: The filter box text matched nothing. Use your language's quotation marks.
queue.summary: Queue header when nothing plays. {time} is a total like "1 hr 5 min".
queue.summaryPlaying: Queue header. {count} tracks after the current one; {time} is the remaining listening time.
queue.showCurrent: Button that scrolls the queue to the playing track.
queue.emptyHint: {playNext} and {addToQueue} are the menu items' names (menu.playNext, menu.addToQueue). Use your language's quotation marks.
queue.autoplay: Divider above tracks TIDAL added automatically after the user's queue.
queue.row: Accessible name of a queue row.
queue.rowAutoplay: Same, for a track added by Autoplay.
queue.removeTrack: Accessible name of a queue row's × button.
queue.dropHidden: Notification after dropping tracks the filters hide.
queue.drag.moving: Drop refused while the queue panel animates.
queue.drag.moveHere: Drop hint when dragging a queue row.
sort.label: Button that adds the first sort level; also the sort bar's accessible name.
sort.thenBy: Menu section heading when a sort exists.
sort.chipLabel: Accessible name of a sort chip. Translate the words inside {…} after asc/other; keep the keywords.
sort.removeLevel: Accessible name of a chip's × button.
sort.option.nameAz: Sort option: alphabetical. Use your alphabet's first and last letters if that reads better.
filter.tracks: Search box that filters the visible list.
filter.loadingAll: Shown while the rest of a long list loads for filtering or sorting.
card.open: Accessible name of a card's cover. {title} is an album/playlist/mix.
card.play: Accessible name of a card's play button.
card.savedMix: Subtitle of a saved mix card.
card.shuffle: Accessible name of a card's shuffle button.
tree.empty: An expanded folder in the sidebar is empty.
playlist.addedCount: Notification. {playlist} is the playlist's title; the number counts tracks.
playlist.addedOne: Notification. {title} is a track, {playlist} a playlist.
playlist.keptDuplicates: Notification: the duplicates were not added again.
playlist.addedCopiesKept: Notification: some duplicates added again, the rest skipped.
playlist.duplicatesFailed: {error} is a technical message (may stay English).
playlist.drop.alreadyHere: Drop refused: the tracks came from this playlist.
playlist.nameLabel: Accessible name of the name field.
playlist.public: Action label: the playlist is public.
playlist.private: Action label: the playlist is private.
playlist.thisPlaylist: Stands in for the playlist's title in collection.deletePlaylistMessage when it is unknown.
playFrom.album: Eyebrow above the source's name in the player bar ("From album" / Album title).
playFrom.other: Same, for any other source (the name follows).
radio.named: A radio station's name. {name} is a track or artist ("Californication radio").
radio.artistRadio: A radio station seeded by an artist.
radio.notFound: The radio could not be loaded.
later.saved: Notification after adding to Save for Later.
later.show: Accessible name of the type chips.
later.empty: Empty page. "Save for later" is menu.laterAdd; use the same words.
feed.group.new: Feed date group: the last 7 days.
feed.new: Badge on an unseen feed entry.
feed.hiresBadge: One-letter badge for Hi-Res releases; keep it one character.
home.greeting: Home page greeting by time of day. Translate the words inside {…}; keep the keywords.
home.startPrompt: Line under the greeting when nothing plays.
home.jumpBackIn: Home section heading: recent playlists and mixes.
home.madeForYou: Home section heading: personal mixes (TIDAL's term).
home.newFromFollowedCount: Same, with the number of unseen releases.
home.becauseYouListen: Home section heading. {name} is an artist.
home.continueListening: Accessible name of the Home hero when paused.
home.trackProgress: Accessible name of the hero's progress bar.
home.playUpNext: Accessible name of the Up next button. {title} is the next track.
profile.yours: Fallback name of the user's own profile card.
detail.coverAlt: Alt text of an album/playlist cover. {title} is its title.
detail.edit: Short action label under the page header.
detail.share: Short action label: copies a link.
detail.more: Short action label: opens more actions.
detail.favorited: Action label when the album is already a favorite.
detail.save: Short action label: add to Save for Later.
detail.saved: Action label when it is in Save for Later.
detail.add: Short action label: add to a playlist.
album.notFound: The album could not be loaded.
artist.editProfile: Action on the user's own artist page.
artist.radio: Short action label: start the artist's radio.
artist.mix: Action label / card subtitle: TIDAL's mix for this artist.
artist.mixNamed: Card title of an artist's mix. {name} is the artist.
artist.ownEmpty: The user's own artist page has nothing to show.
artist.viewAll: Button that opens the full list for a section.
artist.appearsOn: Section heading / tab: releases by others featuring this artist.
artist.notFound: The artist could not be loaded.
artist.sections: Accessible name of the tab bar on the artist's full lists.
artist.tracksUnknown: Shown instead of a count while the total is unknown.
artist.links: Short action label: the artist's web links.
artist.elsewhere: Dialog title listing the artist's web links. {name} is the artist.
artist.website: Label of an artist's own web site link.
artist.link: Label of an unnamed web link.
search.kind.all: Search results filter chip: every type.
search.recent: Heading / accessible name of the recent-search list.
search.suggestions: Accessible name of the suggestion chips.
search.again: Tooltip of a recent-search chip. Use your language's quotation marks.
search.showResults: Accessible name of the result type filter.
search.corrected: TIDAL corrected the spelling; {query} is the corrected text (shown bold).
search.loadMore: Button: loads the next page of results.
search.seeAll: Button: show only this result type.
search.seeAllKind: Accessible name of the See all button. Translate the words inside {…}; keep the keywords.
search.noKind: Empty result list of one type.
search.track: Label on the top result card when it is a track.
section.gone: A TIDAL section page that no longer exists.
tracks.favorites: Shown in the player bar's "From" line for plays started on the Tracks page.
tracks.unavailable: Button: favorites TIDAL no longer serves.
tracks.refreshing: Accessible name of the refresh button while it runs.
albums.sortLabel: Accessible name of the sort menu.
profiles.sortLabel: Accessible name of the sort menu.
mix.notFound: The mix could not be loaded.
nowPlaying.scrobbled: Badge: the play was reported to Last.fm/ListenBrainz.
nowPlaying.content: Accessible name of the lyrics/next-up tabs.
nowPlaying.nextUp: Tab: the next tracks in the queue.
nowPlaying.queueEmpty: Next up tab when nothing follows.
mini.restore: Mini player button: back to the main window.
lyrics.jump: Button that scrolls back to the sung line.
info.credits: Accessible name of the credits list.
login.title: Login screen heading.
login.waiting: Shown while the browser login runs.
login.fallbackToggle: Link that shows the manual login.
login.pasteBack: Button: manual login where the user pastes a URL back.
login.pasteHint: "Oops" is the text TIDAL's page shows; keep it as is.
sleep.title: Button / dialog title: stop playback later.
sleep.remaining: Tooltip. Use your language's short form of minutes.
sleep.custom: Menu item: opens a dialog for any length.
sleep.endOfTrack: Menu item: stop when this track ends.
sleep.customLabel: Field label with the allowed range.
volume.label: Accessible name of the volume slider.
volume.fixed: Tooltip when exclusive output locks the volume. DAC is a digital-to-analog converter (keep the acronym).
seek.label: Accessible name of the seek bar.
cover.none: Accessible name of a missing cover.
profileEdit.usernameRule: TIDAL's username rule (the allowed characters themselves can't change).
profileEdit.notWebLink: Validation error. {href} is what the user typed.
profileEdit.picture: Row label in the profile editor.
profileEdit.banner: Row label: the wide header image.
profileEdit.change: Button. Translate the words inside {…}; keep the keywords.
profileEdit.tidalEditor: Link text: TIDAL's web profile editor.
profileEdit.linkN: Accessible name of the n-th link field.
profileEdit.socialPlaceholder: Placeholder of a social profile field.
profileEdit.sitePlaceholder: Placeholder of a web site field (an example address).
profileEdit.removeLink: Button. {name} is a site name or "Link 2".
